info.title: MORAGO API
info.description:
Translators on call for foreigners in Korea. Log in with POST /api/auth/login, copy the token and press “Authorize”.

Real-time events (Socket.io, same host): call:incoming, call:updated, call:signal (WebRTC offer / answer / ice), message:new, notification:new.

Errors always look like { "error": { "message": "…", "details": [...] } }.

post.summary: Send an SMS code to a phone number (in development the code is returned as devCode)
Register a client or a translator
Log in with phone or email, returns a JWT

Upload an image or a PDF (max 5 MB)
Upload a picture and make it my avatar
